raw: [{"bbox": [84, 74, 582, 91], "category": "Page-header", "text": "KHANG DIEN HOUSE TRADING AND INVESTMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY"}, {"bbox": [561, 100, 687, 115], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Form B 09 - DN/HN"}, {"bbox": [84, 132, 554, 148], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 2 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)"}, {"bbox": [84, 165, 209, 180], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.6 Receivables"}, {"bbox": [129, 198, 688, 327], "category": "Text", "text": "Receivables represent trade receivables from customers arising from sales of goods and rendering of services or non-trade receivables from others and are stated at cost. Provision for doubtful debts is made for each outstanding amount based on overdue days in payment according to the initial payment commitment (exclusive of the payment rescheduling between parties) or based on the estimated loss that may arise. The difference between the provision of this year and the provision of the previous year is recognised as an increase or decrease of general and administrative expenses in the year. Bad debts are written off when identified as uncollectible."}, {"bbox": [129, 344, 687, 393], "category": "Text", "text": "Receivables are classified into short-term and long-term receivables on the consolidated balance sheet based on the remaining period from the consolidated balance sheet date to the maturity date."}, {"bbox": [84, 409, 203, 424], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.7 Inventories"}, {"bbox": [129, 441, 325, 457], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Properties under construction"}, {"bbox": [129, 474, 687, 538], "category": "Text", "text": "Properties acquired or being constructed for sale under the ordinary course of business of the Group, rather than to be held for rental or capital appreciation are recognised as properties under construction. Inventories are stated at the lower of cost incurred in bringing inventories to their present location and condition, and net realisable value."}, {"bbox": [129, 555, 410, 571], "category": "Text", "text": "Cost of properties under construction includes:"}, {"bbox": [129, 587, 331, 603], "category": "List-item", "text": "* Land use rights and land rent;"}, {"bbox": [129, 604, 431, 619], "category": "List-item", "text": "* Construction costs payable to contractors; and"}, {"bbox": [129, 620, 687, 651], "category": "List-item", "text": "* Borrowing costs, planning and design costs, costs of site clearance, professional fees for construction management and other direct related costs."}, {"bbox": [129, 668, 687, 716], "category": "Text", "text": "Net realisable value represents the estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business, based on market prices at the consolidated balance sheet date and less the estimated costs to completion and the estimated costs to sale."}, {"bbox": [129, 733, 687, 782], "category": "Text", "text": "The cost of real estate sold are recognised in the consolidated income statement for the sale transaction at the specific costs of the properties sold and allocated overheads based on the volume of properties sold."}, {"bbox": [380, 984, 394, 997], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "15"}]
